info.title: Prism Inference API
info.description: OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, and Anthropic Messages compatible inference.

200.description: Prism API metadata and discovery links.

messages.description: User image parts are supported by deepseek-v4.1-flash and gemma-4-31b.

reasoning.description: OpenRouter-style reasoning controls. `enabled: false` is equivalent to `reasoning_effort: "none"`. When both fields are present, `reasoning_effort` wins unless `enabled` is `false`.

ReasoningEffort.description: How much the model reasons before answering. Reasoning is on at `high` when no control is sent. `none` disables reasoning so the first token is answer text. Reasoning tokens count toward `max_tokens` and `usage.completion_tokens`.

effort.description: Reasoning is on at `high` when unset. `none` disables it.

ImageDataUrl.description: JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP base64 data URL. Remote URLs are unsupported.

context_length.description: Maximum input context window, in tokens.

max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum number of output tokens the model can generate.

input_cache_read.description: USD cost per cached input token.

messages.description: Image blocks are supported by deepseek-v4.1-flash and gemma-4-31b.

thinking.description: Reasoning is on by default. `disabled` turns it off so the first content block is text. `budget_tokens` is accepted for client compatibility; `max_tokens` bounds thinking and answer together.

OpenAIError.description: OpenAI-compatible error envelope. Every error carries a stable machine-readable `code`, a `retryable` flag, a `fix` hint, and a `docs_url` for the matching entry on the error reference.

retryable.description: Whether the request is safe to retry unchanged.

docs_url.description: Link to the error reference for this code.
